messages:
Maria S: Hey team — Helios Health (POC) just uploaded a SIG/CAIQ + a bespoke security questionnaire (120 Qs). They asked for completed SIG + a point contact by Friday EOD.
sec-bot: New intake created: RH-8342 · status: needs-assignment · priority: high · due: 2026-03-27
Jake P: @Olivia can you triage? Looks like a few infra questions (VPC, KMS, SOC2 scopes) and some app-level ones (data retention, access controls). I can take the app-level Qs if you want the infra ones.
Olivia (Security): Thanks — I can own infra + vendor posture review. Can you upload the CAIQ PDF into the ticket and flag any questions that are already answered in our standard security pack?
Tariq (Sales Eng): Uploaded the CAIQ + the custom questionnaire to RH-8342. Quick note: Helios is evaluating both Hosted API and Dedicated. They asked about encryption-in-transit and at-rest, and whether we support customer-managed keys for Dedicated.
Maria S: They also asked for network diagrams and a list of subprocessors. I attached the current public subprocessor list; we may need to produce a scoped subprocessor list for Dedicated.
Olivia (Security): Got it. Prioritizing these items: 1) KMS/customer-managed keys for Dedicated, 2) SOC2 scope confirmation, 3) network diagrams / VPC architecture, 4) subprocessor list. If we can answer 1-3 quickly that's ~70% of questionnaire.
Jake P: Suggest we answer common boilerplate Qs with our standard responses. I'll paste the standard snippets for encryption + SOC2 here.
Jake P: ```
Encryption in transit: TLS1.2+ with modern ciphers.
Encryption at rest: AES-256; host keys managed by Redwood for Hosted.
Dedicated: supports customer-managed keys via KMS integration (AWS KMS / GCP KMS).
SOC2: Redwood Inference is SOC2 Type II with scope including hosted inference and control plane; Dedicated contracts can include attestation options.
```
Olivia (Security): That looks good. I need the exact wording for customer-managed keys (what we commit in contract) — Tariq, can you confirm the integration matrix and whether HSM/KMS options require Private deployment?
Tariq (Sales Eng): Confirmed: Dedicated can be configured with customer KMS in most cloud regions; on-prem/private supports HSM. I'll list region limitations in the ticket.
Maria S: Helios asked for an example SLA for dedicated latency—we should avoid promising numbers here in the questionnaire but link them to our Dedicated offering page / SLA doc.
Olivia (Security): I'll draft answers for the infra Qs and mark anything that needs legal/contract language. Jake/Tariq please mark any question where we need product wording or contract.
Jake P: Marked Qs 12, 15, 33 as "sales wording needed" in RH-8342. Also flagged 78 (data deletion timeline) — we normally say 30 days after contract termination unless otherwise contracted.
Olivia (Security): Solid. I'll push a first pass by tomorrow noon. If @Maria S can approve language, we can send partial SIG + ask for an extension on the rest if needed.
Maria S: We should ask for a 1-week extension proactively; POC timeline is flexible. I'll DM the buyer now. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: RH-8342 status updated -> in-review (assignee: Olivia (Security))
Olivia (Security): Posting my draft answers in the ticket now. Two Qs that need legal: Q45 (data residency guarantees) and Q99 (subprocessor liability).
Tariq (Sales Eng): Noted. For Q45 we can offer region pinning on Dedicated but Hosted customers are region-replicated per policy. I'll add the region-pin config snippet.
Jake P: Also adding a short network diagram link: https://redwood-internal/diagrams/dedicated-vpc.png
Olivia (Security): Great. Plan: I finish infra answers + CAIQ mapping today, Jake/Tariq finish app/contract bits, Maria sends extension request. If legal sign-off needed, I'll loop them on Q45 & Q99.
Maria S: Thanks team — tagging this as high priority. I'll update the customer once we have the SIG and draft answers.
Jake P: :rocket:
Olivia (Security): Leaving notes in RH-8342. Ping me in-thread if anything changes.
